context: Sakura and Ren discuss a documentary on a leader.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; vocabulary (権力/常識/真実/発想/要因) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あの指導者、権力を握ってたんだね。
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ええ、でも真実を隠したのが要因で倒れたの。
lines.en: Yes, but hiding the truth was the factor in his fall.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 常識を超えた発想も、あったよね。
lines.en: He also had ideas beyond common sense.
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: その発想が、最初は人を惹きつけたの。
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 権力に酔うのが、失敗の要因かな。
lines.en: Getting drunk on power was the factor in failure.
lines.style: analytical young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 真実を、無視できなかったのね。
lines.en: He couldn't ignore the truth in the end.
lines.style: thoughtful adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 常識を疑う発想は、諸刃だね。
lines.en: Doubting common sense is a double-edged idea.
lines.style: understanding young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 権力と真実、難しい関係ね。
lines.en: Power and truth — a difficult relationship.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
